title: Drinking Enough Water
paragraphs: Nadia sering lupa minum air saat sedang sibuk dengan rapat yang berturut-turut di siang hari. Menjelang sore, seluruh tubuhnya mulai terasa lelah, kepalanya sedikit pusing, dan ia tidak bisa fokus dengan baik pada pekerjaannya.

Suatu malam, kakak perempuannya memberinya botol air kecil sebagai hadiah. "Cobalah minum sedikit setiap jam, bahkan saat rapat," sarannya dengan baik. Nadia memutuskan untuk benar-benar mencoba kebiasaan baru ini.

Setelah hanya beberapa hari melakukannya, Nadia sudah merasa lebih segar, lebih fokus, dan penuh energi sepanjang hari kerjanya. Ia bahkan menyadari sakit kepalanya di sore hari hampir sepenuhnya hilang sejak ia mulai kebiasaan ini.

Nadia menceritakan perubahan kecil ini kepada rekan-rekan kerjanya, dan beberapa dari mereka mulai melakukan hal yang sama. Minum air yang cukup sepanjang hari, ia pelajari, ternyata benar-benar kebiasaan kecil dengan hasil yang mengejutkan besar.
answerKey: Nadia often forgets to drink water while she is busy with back-to-back meetings during the day. By the afternoon, her whole body starts to feel tired, her head hurts a little, and she cannot focus properly on her work. One evening, her older sister gives her a small water bottle as a gift. "Try to drink a little every single hour, even during meetings," she suggests kindly. Nadia decides to give this new habit a real try. After only a few days of doing this, Nadia already feels more awake, more focused, and full of energy throughout her workday. She even notices her afternoon headaches have almost completely disappeared since she started. Nadia mentions this small change to her colleagues, and a few of them start doing the same. Drinking enough water throughout the day, she learns, is truly a small habit with a surprisingly large result.
